description: Lightweight token/context telemetry for the interactive execution path. Provider token counts are NOT available in this environment; record byte/char/count PROXIES and label them clearly as proxies. Never fabricate provider token numbers.
proxyDisclaimer: All 'token' figures are proxies computed as ceil(bytes/4) unless a real provider count is supplied. Always label them 'proxy'.

metricsPerRun.repeatedContentBytes: integer (bytes of snapshots identical to a prior snapshot in the run)

howToMeasure.snapshotBytes: Sum the byte size of each browser_snapshot response captured (the .playwright-mcp/page-*.yml artifacts are a durable proxy source).
howToMeasure.evaluateBytes: Sum the byte size of each browser_evaluate JSON result.
howToMeasure.repeatedContent: Count a snapshot as repeated when its content equals a previously captured snapshot in the same run.
howToMeasure.proxyTokens: ceil(bytes / 4). Label 'proxy'. If a real provider token count is available, record it separately as 'providerTokens' and prefer it.

output.rule: Write one telemetry record per interactive run. Include a 'proxy: true' flag on all token figures unless providerTokens is present.
output.baselineComparison: When a baseline record exists for the same scenario, also emit absolute and percentage deltas per metric, labelled proxy.

acceptanceSignals.note: Do NOT optimize for fewer tool calls alone. Optimize for minimum unnecessary context + response size + repeated info, with full correctness and full failure diagnosis.
